Apprenticeship of Edward Concealer (Conceilor) son of Priscilla (---) Muntz of Kent County, Delaware

1834

Contributed by Mollie Steward 2012

An apprentice indenture was an actual manuscript contract by which a person or persons, generally a minor, was bound to serve another in his trade, art, or occupation for a stated time, for the purpose of being instructed in the same. This document is in the custody of Delaware Public Archives, Dover, Delaware
